answer.reason: Different business model and customers: Wendy’s serves made-to-order restaurant meals to consumers and recruits franchise owners; SunOpta manufactures beverages, ingredients, broths and snacks and supplies brands, retailers and foodservice providers. Their broad food-sector connection does not establish comparable offerings or buyers.
